question: Which country hosted the FIFA World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FIFA World Cup 2022** was hosted by **Qatar**, making it the first time the tournament was held in the **Middle East region.**
 
• The tournament took place from **20 November to 18 December 2022**, coinciding with Qatar's National Day on the final match day.
 
• It was a unique edition as it was the **first FIFA World Cup to be held during the winter months** (November-December) due to the extreme summer heat in Qatar.
 
• Qatar invested heavily in infrastructure, spending approximately **$220 billion** to prepare for the tournament, including building **eight state-of-the-art stadiums**, transportation systems, and accommodations.
 
• **Argentina**, led by captain **Lionel Messi**, emerged as the champion after defeating **France** in the final, which ended in a dramatic penalty shootout (3-3 in regular time, 4-2 in penalties).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Features of Qatar’s FIFA World Cup:**

 
 
• The tournament featured **32 teams** from across the globe, competing in **64 matches**.
 
• Qatar constructed **8 new stadiums**, including the famous **Lusail Iconic Stadium**, which hosted the final match.
 
• Sustainability was a priority, with the **Stadium 974** being the first fully demountable stadium in World Cup history, made from shipping containers.
 
• Qatar showcased its rich culture and traditions, blending football with its heritage to offer a unique experience for fans worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Notable Moments:**
 
 
• The 2022 edition saw several upsets, including **Saudi Arabia’s historic win against Argentina** in the group stage.
 
• Morocco became the first African team to reach the **semi-finals**, creating history and inspiring the continent.
 
• **Lionel Messi** won the **Golden Ball** for being the best player of the tournament, while **Kylian Mbappé** was awarded the **Golden Boot** for scoring the most goals (8).
 
 
 
• **Economic Impact:**
 
 
• Hosting the FIFA World Cup boosted Qatar’s global image and economy, attracting tourists and investments.
 
• The tournament led to significant growth in the hospitality and transportation sectors, with millions of visitors attending the event.
 
 
 
• **Other Host Countries in FIFA History:**
 
 
• **Russia** hosted the FIFA World Cup in **2018**, where France won the championship.
 
• **Brazil** hosted in **2014**, with Germany emerging as the winner.
 
• Future hosts include **Canada, Mexico, and the USA** in **2026**, marking the first tri-nation World Cup.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Why Qatar’s Selection Was Historic:**

 
 
• Qatar was chosen to host the tournament in **2010** by the FIFA Executive Committee.
 
• This marked the first time the FIFA World Cup was held in the **Arab world**, promoting inclusivity and regional representation in football.
 
• The decision faced scrutiny and criticism over **human rights concerns** and working conditions for migrant laborers. However, Qatar implemented reforms to address these issues.
 
 
 
• **Technological Innovations:**
 
 
• The 2022 World Cup introduced the **semi-automated offside technology** for more accurate and faster referee decisions.
 
• State-of-the-art cooling systems were used in stadiums to ensure comfortable conditions for players and fans.
